content:
5DN1L might be more detailed later if he comes, but a brief overview:
Goal:
   * Please format 'd', 'n', 'm', and 't' as [[variables]]
Input:
   * Please remove all instances of '•'
   * Please format 'Line 1', 'Line 2',... in <<bold>>
   * Please format 'd', 'n', 'm', and 't' as [[variables]]
Output:
   * Please rephrase along the idea of: <<Line 1>>: {{SHISHISHI}} if there is enough meat else {{I'm hungry Sandy}}.
   * Please remove all instances of '•'
Constraints:
   * Please be more specific, and format along the lines of:
      1 <= [[m]] <= (number)
      And so on for the others
Thanks!
Note:
- Does this count as binary-outputted?
Thank you very much. I'm making the changes right away. Yes, there are only two possible outputs, is that something I should change?
I'm not sure how. One way might be to say something if not enough, another if more than enough, and if just enough one last thing?

And also in the Input/Output, format 'm', 'k', 'd', 't' as [[variables]] (for example [[m]]) as well as in the constraints. The last constraint is unnecessary, as the constraints above made sure of that. Finally, in the output, format 'SHISHISHI' and 'I'm hungry Sandy' as {{constants}}. 

Thanks.
Yes, the issue of binary output means having only two possible outputs, and that should be avoided for clash of code.
Thank you again :-D ! I'm updating it right away.
This looks much better! Thank you! If there is any flaws left, I'll leave it to 5DN1L since, to me, it looks clean.
Thank you, okay I'll change that. I just need to do a bit of thinking fist to decide what I'd like people to do ^^

Goal
* Please replace all hyphens ("-") following variable names with spaces.

Goal / Input / Constraints / Stub generator
* [[c]] is used in the Goal section and the stub generator, while [[d]] is used in the Input and Constraints sections. Please standardise the variable name across all sections.

Input
* Please start each variable description with "An integer" (e.g. Line 1: An integer [[m]]…).

Output
* Please start a new line with "SHISHISHI".

* Please add ", or" after "enough meat".

* Please remove the second occurrence of "A single line:".

* Please start a new line with "I'm hungry".

* For my information only, what does "SHISHISHI" mean?

Cases
* These cases are the same:
  • Validator 1
  • Test 3

  Note that each test and its corresponding validator should cover the same scenario using similar inputs and outputs, but no two cases should be the same (unless it's an edge case).

* Validator 4 violates the constraint on [[t]]. Please fix the case.

* Please revise the cases so that, for both the test and the validator in each case pair, k / c (as calculated in your solution) falls into one of the following categories:
  • An integer.
  • A value with a fractional part of 0.5 or greater.
  • A value with a fractional part of less than 0.5

* Please revise or add cases so that each of the following scenarios is covered by at least one case pair:
  • m = k / c exactly.
  • m = k / c only after rounding up, where the fractional part is 0.5 or greater.
  • m = k / c only after rounding up, where the fractional part is less than 0.5.

* There's a significant gap between the input and output values used in Pair 4 and Pair 5. Please add intermediate cases to bridge this gap and make fuller use of the allowed ranges of m, k, d and t.

Thanks.
Amazing! Thank you so much for having taken the time to review this so thoroughly! I'll make the changes today.
(and SHISHISHI is simply the way the character I'm referring to laughs.)

No problem! And thanks for the explanation.

Just let me know when you've finished the changes and I'll be happy to review the contribution again.
